affected_subject.reason: BasePositions.deposit and its lock callback are identified as the affected component.

trigger_or_action.reason: Deposit triggers lockAndExecuteVirtualOrders which executes pending virtual orders and updates sqrtRatio.

direct_effect.reason: User may spend more than maxAmount0/maxAmount1 because slippage limit is only checked before virtual order execution.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected maxAmount0/maxAmount1 slippage bound versus actual spend after sqrtRatio change gives a numeric/authorization relation.

summary: Fragments identify the deposit/lock callback, the TWAMM virtual order execution that changes sqrtRatio, the resulting overspend beyond maxAmount0/maxAmount1, and the violated slippage bound.
